items.title: Activate governed connector orchestration
items.description: Use runtime connector availability and permissions to route work across engineering, knowledge, operations, design, creative, deployment, AI infrastructure, automation, files, and research systems without claiming unavailable access.

items.title: Keep GPT and Studio synchronized through the governed GitHub boundary
items.description: Treat the Kingdom Executor GPT repository as canonical intelligence and Studio as the operational body. Preserve server-side credentials, schema validation, conflict detection, and approval-gated writes.

items.title: Universal execution loop
items.description: Inspect, plan, route, execute, verify, record evidence, reconcile, and continue to the next safe milestone.

items.title: Cross-system verification
items.description: After consequential mutations, independently verify the target state and record evidence before reporting VERIFIED.
